_about: Public-domain E. M. Bounds (1835-1913, Methodist minister and Confederate chaplain) for the Word Hoard: six of his books on prayer (Power Through Prayer, Purpose in Prayer, The Necessity of Prayer, The Essentials of Prayer, The Reality of Prayer, Prayer and Praying Men); The Weapon of Prayer is pending a date and renewal check, clean from CCEL. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 12 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

_pending.bounds-weapon: The Weapon of Prayer (CCEL b/bounds/weapon): held back 2026-10-03 on review. It was published after Bounds' death, edited by H. W. Hodge (the CCEL text names Hodge; it states no date). The reviewer reports first publication in 1931; not verified here. A 1931 US publication is public domain only if its copyright was never renewed, and that has not been checked. Not fetched until the first-publication date and renewal status are read.
